£1.1 billion. At the seed stage. One company.

Ineffable Intelligence just closed the largest seed round in history — a £1.1B raise valuing the company at $5.1 billion. The founder is David Silver, the former DeepMind executive who led the team behind AlphaGo. The UK government backed the deal directly through its Sovereign AI fund.

The mission: build AI that learns through experience rather than human input. Not another foundation model trained on internet data. A fundamentally different approach — self-improving systems that adapt without the data bottlenecks limiting current AI.
